title: in-toto Attestation Framework — Statement layer, v1
description: JSON Schema for the in-toto Statement v1 (https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1). Authored in-repo from the normative upstream specification; upstream ships no JSON Schema for this layer (only Markdown + protobuf). Provenance, source-document hashes, and every deliberate divergence are recorded in schemas/sources.json and schemas/README.md.
$comment: additionalProperties is deliberately permissive at every object level: spec/v1/README.md 'Parsing rules' requires consumers to IGNORE unrecognized fields, and explicitly permits producer extension fields. A schema with additionalProperties:false here would reject spec-conformant documents.

_type.description: Identifier for the schema of the Statement. Always https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1 for this version of the spec. (spec/v1/statement.md)

subject.description: Set of software artifacts the attestation applies to. Non-empty; every element MUST set digest. (spec/v1/statement.md; go/v1/statement.go ErrSubjectRequired, ErrDigestRequired)

predicateType.description: TypeURI identifying the type of the Predicate. (spec/v1/statement.md; spec/v1/field_types.md#TypeURI)

predicate.description: Additional parameters of the Predicate. Optional per spec/v1/statement.md: 'Unset is treated the same as set-but-empty. MAY be omitted if predicateType fully describes the predicate.'

typeUri.description: Uniform Resource Identifier (RFC 3986) used as a collision-resistant type identifier. RFC 3986 s6.2.2.1 case normalization requires a lowercase scheme. Authority-case normalization is NOT enforced here — see schemas/README.md 'Residual risk'.

digestSet.description: Map of algorithm name to a string encoding of the digest. Named standard algorithms are constrained to lowercase hex of the algorithm's exact digest length; custom algorithms are accepted as any non-empty string, per spec/v1/digest_set.md and go/v1/resource_descriptor.go (isSupportedAlgorithm).

subjectResourceDescriptor.description: A ResourceDescriptor appearing in Statement.subject. v1 Statements require digest to be set on every subject element (go/v1/statement.go: 'v1 statements require the digest to be set in the subject').
